name: Mage
description: Mage is an open-source data pipeline tool for building, running and monitoring ETL and ELT pipelines. Pipelines are made of Python, SQL or R blocks edited in a notebook-style UI, and run on schedules, events or API triggers, with data integrations for syncing sources into warehouses.

notes.text: Sign in as admin@admin.com with DEFAULT_OWNER_PASSWORD from /opt/mage-ai_data/.env, then change it in the user settings. The value in .env is only used to create the first owner.
Every signed-in user can run code and open a terminal as root inside the container. Keep port 6789 on a trusted network.

app_vars.name: var_mage_password
app_vars.label: Owner Password
app_vars.help: Password for admin@admin.com, generated when left empty
